paragraphs.text: These pearls are [Yunnan white](yunnan-white:definition), made from the large-leaf tea plants of Yunnan. The leaf was withered and dried [the white tea way](yunnan-white:making), then rolled into dragon pearls by hand. Each pearl was shaped on its own while the leaf was still pliable, which makes this slow work.

The rolling is what sets this tea apart. [White tea](white:definition) is not normally rolled or bruised, so the leaf keeps its natural shape and oxidises only a little, by its own enzymes. Shaping each pearl bruises the leaf slightly, and that gives this tea a faint layer of oxidation on top of the white tea base.

brewing.text: Yunnan white is brewed gently, as a white tea is, in a gaiwan or small pot, and it gives many infusions; the leaf holds up well.

notice.text: A honeyed, sweet cup, often richer and fuller than Fujian white, with little bitterness, sometimes fruit like apricot or melon and a hay or herbal note. Yabao is sweet and silky, often with pine or herbal notes.
